errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.WRONG_PHASE: This action is not possible in the current phase.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.STALE: This view is out of date. Only the most recently opened tab may write.
errors.ROOM_FULL: The room is full (10 players maximum).
errors.KICKED: You were removed from this room.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many actions. Please wait a moment.
errors.INVALID_ROOM_CODE: A room code is 6 letters (without O and I).
errors.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: No room found with that code.

config.title: Supabase configuration missing
config.body: Please set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: locally in .env.local, on Vercel under Settings → Environment Variables. Then restart or redeploy.

home.heading: Create or join a room
home.intro: Create a new room or join with a 6-character room code.
home.joinCodeHint: 6 letters from A–Z (without O and I).
home.identityMissing: No recoverable identity was found for this link. Please enter a nickname.
home.storageNotice: Only a local player ID is stored so a reload recognizes you. No login, no saved game.

milestone.title: Milestone M3
milestone.body: Genre roulette and song submission are live. Playback, voting and reveal arrive in M4 and M5.
milestone.startHint: The host starts the round once 3–10 players are ready (sound enabled).

lobby.heading: Lobby
lobby.copyFailed: Copying is not possible. Please select the link and copy it manually.
lobby.readOnly: This tab is read-only. Only an active connection authorized for your player can send actions.
lobby.settingsHostOnly: Only the host can change the rules.

sound.consentExplainer: A click is required so the browser may play audio. It does not confirm playback through YouTube.
sound.failed: Sound could not be enabled. Please try again.
sound.readinessWaiting: Waiting for at least {{min}} ready players.

phase.spectator: You are watching and will play from the next round.

genre.heading: Genre roulette
genre.fixedNotice: Fixed genre: no spin, every round uses this genre.

submission.heading: Submit a song
submission.intro: Submit the biggest banger of the genre as a YouTube link.
submission.linkHint: Supported: youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/…, /shorts/…, music.youtube.com and m.youtube.com. Other domains are rejected.
submission.linkInvalid: Not a valid YouTube link. Please enter a supported URL.
submission.consentLabel: I agree that YouTube content (preview player and thumbnail) is loaded.
submission.consentRequired: Please consent to YouTube embedding first.
submission.embeddingBlocked: This video cannot be embedded (code {{code}}). Please pick another link.
submission.previewUnavailable: The preview is unavailable (code {{code}}). The video is therefore not confirmed.
submission.previewFailed: The preview could not be started. Please try again.
submission.metadataFailed: The metadata could not be loaded.
submission.autoplayBlocked: The browser blocked playback. Please click “Play preview” again.
submission.clipLabel: Clip: {{clip}} s from the start point
submission.finished: You are done. You can watch until the submission time ends.
submission.spectatorOnly: You are a spectator and may submit from the next round.
submission.previewRequired: A playing preview first confirms that the video is playable.

linked.heading: Spiritually Linked
linked.single: Only one song this round: no voting, no points.

host.notReadyCount: At least {{min}} active players are required.
host.notReadySound: Not every player has enabled sound yet.

later.PLAYBACK: Synchronised playback arrives in M4. The clips are not played here yet.
later.VOTING: Voting arrives in M5. Nothing is ranked here yet.
later.REVEAL: Reveal and scoring arrive in M5. This is not a result yet.
